node.acceptance_condition: Returns a three-part write-up labeled (a) strongest plain form, (b) honest concession, (c) surviving rebuttal, in essay-register prose, showing how curation functions as taste and where that reframing can be pressed too far.
node.expected_contribution: A finished, reusable steelman block on the intention-and-curation objection with its concession and rebuttal, ready for synthesis.
node.objective: Develop the counterargument that the human acts of prompting, selecting, and curating AI outputs supply precisely the intention, discernment, and taste that kitsch is said to lack. Produce (a) its strongest plain-language form, (b) the honest concession, and (c) the rebuttal that remains available to the thesis.
node.rationale: This is the second independent strong objection. It rests on an account of the AI-art workflow and of what kitsch is missing (intention/taste), self-contained logical work with no need of sibling output.
